metadata.Name: JGL-QA
metadata.Description: JGL-QA is a Japanese Question Answering dataset created from Japanese literature. It contains 13,178 question-answer pairs extracted from 132 Japanese novels.
Provider: Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: JGL-QA: A Japanese Question Answering Dataset from Literature
Affiliations: Japan Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: We introduce JGL-QA, a Japanese Question Answering (QA) dataset constructed from Japanese literature. JGL-QA comprises 13,178 question-answer pairs extracted from 132 Japanese novels. The dataset is designed to evaluate the reading comprehension abilities of language models in the context of long-form narrative texts. We provide detailed statistics of the dataset, including question types, answer lengths, and the distribution of source novels. We also conduct preliminary experiments using several pre-trained language models and demonstrate the effectiveness of JGL-QA as a challenging benchmark for Japanese QA. The dataset is publicly available to facilitate further research in this area.
